# Switzerland

[global-law](../) / Switzerland

79 repositories under this folder (1 legislation, whole country, 51 legislation, subdivisions, 27 case law): see [REPOSITORIES.md](REPOSITORIES.md).

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 99% | 96% | 100% |

Federal law is close to complete and accurate: switzerland-law holds 5,046 of the 5,110 SR texts Fedlex lists as in force, all eight essentials, and the OR and StGB match Fedlex article for article. But main also keeps 520 SR texts Fedlex marks as no longer in force with nothing to show they were repealed, it stopped on 2026-10-28 so 38 versions in force since 1 November (the Flight Passenger Data Act and its amendments) sit only on the future branch, full text history mostly starts in 2021, and Schwyz is the one canton with no law repository.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
